doc: sun6-second-checker-v1 future resource, lifecycle and settlement plan
status: PROPOSAL ONLY. Nothing has run. Each item needs parent source review, a separate item GO, a fresh stability/resource gate and the parent's five-part release; the shared supervisor owns launch, identity, signalling and settlement. This lane launches nothing and reimplements no scheduler/guardian.

common.interpreter: CPython >= 3.8, standard library only (no NumPy/scipy/LP solver/native extension); exact interpreter path chosen and recorded by the parent (the eval kernel used for authoring reports 3.14.3); report records sys.version

env.TMPDIR: /Users/jinleic/repos/aifours/institute/runs/six-lane-2026-10-18-96h/review/sun6-second-checker-v1/tmp-env (supervisor-created; the programs create no temporary files)

common.process_model: one process, one thread, no children, no network, no subprocess; reads pinned inputs read-only; writes only into a NEW out-dir created with mkdir (exclusive) and files opened O_EXCL; never deletes or overwrites
common.input_pins: INPUT-PINS-v1.json (four files + decompressed orbit bytes); the checker hard-codes and enforces them before parsing

items.purpose: frozen intended-reason controls (124) before the replay; any MISMATCH/ERROR/SETUP_ERROR => HOLD replay pending review
items.stop: deadline checked before each control and inside checker loops; SIGTERM/SIGINT set a flag honoured between controls (in-control work is bounded: the costliest controls are three leaf enumerations and I15, which stops at its 3000th guard check)
items.settlement: exit code observed by supervisor; CONTROLS-RESULT.json present (O_EXCL); exit 2 => STOPPED, never counted as pass

items.purpose: full replay of the pinned Sun6 certificate set by the second independent checker

estimates_INFERENCE.drivers: 8 leaf enumerations (1,575,031 leaves total per the untrusted run.json), ~3.5M orbit images, 324,428 RLP q-lookups (memoised by (q,status)), 134 FH5 witnesses x 7 placements with pruned exhaustive search (engine-informational unpruned total 26,412,500), 385 RPLP P vectors

items.stop: SIGTERM/SIGINT handler sets a latched flag; deadline/cancel-file latched; checked between units and every 2048 enumeration/FH5 nodes; remaining lines INCOMPLETE; verdict INCOMPLETE exit 2; a PASS stopped after the gate is downgraded before publication; no SIGKILL needed for bounded stop
settlement_PASS_requires_all: run-replay-v1/REPORT.seal.json exists, its report_sha256 equals sha256(REPORT.json) and verdict == PASS
REPORT.json gate: every boolean true; verdict PASS; witnesses verified == total == 61124; failed 0; incomplete 0
REPORT.json inputs.files match INPUT-PINS-v1.json and run.source_sha256 == checker pin
report.universe: 8 types, coverage.clean true, missing 0, duplicates empty

non_pass_outcomes.4: PUBLICATION FAILURE (out-dir exists or write error; no seal)

items.jobs_over_3600s: not expected; if the parent sets a budget >= 3600 s the 300 s stability observation applies

not_included: No re-chunking, no parallel split, no nested agents, no model CLI. Peak RSS/wall figures above are author estimates, not measurements; the supervisor must measure.
